notes.en: Official Runway research page used to verify the system name, the Anastasis Germanidis byline, eight conditioning modes and Runway's self-reported preference results.
notes.zh: Runway 官方研究页，用于核对系统名称、Anastasis Germanidis 署名、八种条件模式与 Runway 自报的偏好测试结果。

title.zh: Gen2 的 OpenAlex 文献记录

notes.en: Bibliographic metadata is retained only as a secondary cross-check; technical and identity claims use primary records.
notes.zh: 书目元数据仅作为辅助交叉核对；技术与人物主张使用原始记录。

notes.en: Authority for annual membership, official work name, order, contributors, institution, country, and citation field.
notes.zh: 年度成员、官方成果名称、顺序、主要人物、机构、国家与引用数字段的权威依据。

notes.en: Researcher-controlled page identifying Germanidis as a Runway co-founder and co-CEO focused on research efforts in video-generation models, with direct links to Gen-2 and the Ray Summit talk used for the portrait candidate.
notes.zh: 研究者本人维护的页面，说明 Germanidis 是 Runway 联合创始人、联合 CEO，专注视频生成模型研究，并直接链接 Gen-2 与用于肖像候选核验的 Ray Summit 演讲。

title.en: A Brief History of Video Generation: Runway Co-founder Anastasis Germanidis
title.zh: 《视频生成简史：Runway 联合创始人 Anastasis Germanidis》

notes.en: Anyscale's official Ray Summit 2024 video and thumbnail clearly name and depict Germanidis. His personal homepage links to this exact video; the thumbnail is a reliable identity match but is not selected because BenchCouncil lists no official contributor for Gen2.
notes.zh: Anyscale 发布的 Ray Summit 2024 官方视频及缩略图清楚标注并展示 Germanidis；其个人网站直接链接到该视频。缩略图的人物身份匹配可靠，但 Gen2 的 BenchCouncil 官方人物字段为空，因此不选用为事件肖像。

title.en: Runway's Video Revolution, with CTO Anastasis
title.zh: 《Runway 的视频革命：与 CTO Anastasis 对谈》

notes.en: The 2024 interview page identifies Anastasis Germanidis as a Runway co-founder and CTO and publishes a cover containing his clear portrait. The cover also contains two hosts and promotional text, so it is documented as a secondary candidate rather than selected as a standalone portrait.
notes.zh: 这篇 2024 年访谈将 Anastasis Germanidis 标明为 Runway 联合创始人、CTO，并发布包含其清晰头像的封面。封面同时包含两位主持人和宣传文字，因此只记录为备用候选，不选作独立人物肖像。

title.zh: Runway Gen-2 研究页介绍图片

notes.en: Official Runway-hosted image associated with the Gen-2 research page. It is a strong event-image candidate, but this package retains the required original local explainer as its single selected event visual; no redistribution license is stated.
notes.zh: Runway 官方托管、与 Gen-2 研究页关联的介绍图片。它是可靠的事件图片候选，但本事件继续以必需的本地原创解释图作为唯一选用的事件视觉；来源未声明再分发许可。

title.zh: Gen-2 模式 01 文生视频示例帧

notes.en: Still frame hosted and embedded by Runway under Mode 01: Text to Video, paired with the prompt about late-afternoon sunlight in a New York City loft. It is a stronger explanatory product image than the abstract Open Graph image, but any use must label it as a generated example rather than documentary photography.
notes.zh: Runway 在“模式 01：文生视频”下官方托管并嵌入的示例帧，对应纽约阁楼午后阳光的提示词。它比抽象的 Open Graph 主图更适合说明产品能力，但使用时必须标注为生成示例，不能让观众误以为是真实纪实摄影。

title.en: Structure and Content-Guided Video Synthesis with Diffusion Models
title.zh: 《使用扩散模型进行结构与内容引导的视频合成》

notes.en: Runway’s preceding Gen-1 paper provides technical background for structure- and content-guided video generation; it is not presented as a full technical specification of Gen-2. Figure 2 is the paper's most useful architecture overview, separating training from inference and showing the autoencoder, diffusion model, MiDaS structure signal and CLIP content signal.
notes.zh: Runway 的 Gen-1 论文提供结构与内容引导视频生成的技术背景；不把它视为 Gen-2 的完整技术说明。论文 Figure 2 是最有说明力的架构总览，区分训练与推理，并展示自编码器、扩散模型、MiDaS 结构信号与 CLIP 内容信号。

title.en: Gen-1 paper Figure 2: training and inference overview
title.zh: Gen-1 论文 Figure 2：训练与推理总览

notes.en: Publisher-rendered copy of Figure 2 from the Gen-1 paper. It is a useful commonly cited technical screenshot for the Runway video-diffusion lineage, but it must not be captioned as the disclosed architecture of Gen-2. The existing local explainer remains preferred for display because it avoids that attribution risk.
notes.zh: Gen-1 论文 Figure 2 的论文 HTML 渲染图。它适合作为 Runway 视频扩散技术脉络中常见的技术截图，但不得标注成 Gen-2 已公开架构。现有本地原创解释图仍更适合页面展示，因为可以避免这种归属误读。

title.zh: Runway 品牌资产与使用指南

notes.en: Runway's official brand page provides a downloadable logo pack and states that the company name should appear as 'Runway,' not 'Runway AI' or 'RunwayML.' It requires the wordmark to stand alone, permits the symbol as a substitute in small applications, sets a 24-pixel minimum digital height and specifies black-on-light or white-on-dark usage. Downloading the pack requires acceptance of Runway's applicable guidelines and terms, so no unrestricted redistribution license should be inferred.
notes.zh: Runway 官方品牌页提供可下载的 Logo Pack，并明确公司名称应写作“Runway”，而不是“Runway AI”或“RunwayML”。指南要求字标单独使用，小尺寸场景可用符号替代，数字媒体中的标识高度不得小于 24 像素，并规定浅色背景使用黑色字标、深色背景使用白色字标。下载素材包即表示接受 Runway 的适用指南与条款，因此不能推断为不受限制的再分发许可。

notes.en: Runway's official homepage organization metadata declares this company-hosted PNG as its logo. The file is a 571 by 128 transparent wordmark and is selected as the event's institution-identification image ahead of the original Gen-2 explainer. It must remain unmodified on a light background and must not be rotated, skewed or combined with the separate symbol.
notes.zh: Runway 官方首页的机构结构化数据将这张公司托管 PNG 声明为 Logo。文件为 571×128 的透明背景字标，现选作事件的机构识别图，排列在原创 Gen-2 解释图之前。展示时必须保持图形不变并使用浅色背景，不得旋转、倾斜或与独立符号自行组合。
